title: Restoring Negative Potential
text: After depolarisation, the inside of the membrane is positive (+40mV). To return to the negative resting potential (-70mV), positive charges must leave the cell. Which positive ion is more concentrated INSIDE the cell and would move out?

title: Sequence of Events
text: The sequence is: (1) Stimulus reaches threshold, (2) Na+ channels open - Na+ enters (depolarisation), (3) Na+ channels close, (4) K+ channels open - K+ exits (repolarisation), (5) K+ channels close, (6) Na+/K+ pump restores ion gradients. The ion that leaves to restore negativity is potassium.
